qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews on the shared initial commit and serialized fix rechecks found the original correctness, comprehensibility and quiz-safety defects resolved. 避ける now qualifies the inherited categorical よける/さける split against the デジタル大辞泉 usage note; 都市 is titled «город; городское поселение» instead of the misleading «городской центр». Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.
qualifiedVerdicts.fallbackAndVoice: Tag/random fallback options, voice/reading prompts and drawing not cleared.
qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 14 EN exclusions are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received direct, one-sided exclusions, including 金融–経済/金銭/お金/金; 金/金銭–経済; 金曜–金曜日; 数/量–多少; 重大–大変/まじめ/大した/相当; 便/郵便–郵便局; 選択–選ぶ; 適用–用; 適切–適する/合う/いい; 銃–武器; 都市–町; 野–畑; and, after review, 鉄/銀–金属 under the generic-label rule. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 12 relative links across the 8 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 28 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 0 of the 91-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (30 of 2,727 remaining EN words, recomputed after Batch 188). Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing was added. 針→ピン, 金→金属, 金銭→金, 量→数, 郵便→便 and 適度→適切 are the dependency edges inside the batch.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped: 銅貨→kanji 貨/銅 and 硬貨; 鉄道→kanji 鉄 and 航空; 鉄→kanji 鉄; 針→kanji 針; 金, 金銭 and 金融→現金; 金曜→土曜 and 木曜; 金庫→kanji 庫; 数→数字; 量→kanji 量 and 質; 重視→無視; 酸素→化学; 郵便→kanji 郵; 部分→全体; 選手→チーム and 参加; 適用→使用. Sixteen written kanji have no RU kanji card: 銅, 貨, 銃, 鉄, 針, 属, 銭, 融, 庫, 量, 視, 酸, 素, 郵, 避, 択.
